theorem polarisRigidAdjacencyAndManufacturerBoundary :
    let rigidFittings : Nat := 28
    let resolvedRigidFittings : Nat := 28
    let unresolvedRigidFittings : Nat := 0
    let identifiedVictaulicFittings : Nat := 22
    let genericUnresolvedFittings : Nat := 6
    let primaryDimensionRecords : Nat := 9
    let sourceAdjacencyReady : Bool := resolvedRigidFittings == rigidFittings && unresolvedRigidFittings == 0
    let primaryDimensionScheduleReady : Bool := primaryDimensionRecords == 9
    let sourceInsertOriginToPortOffsetReady : Bool := false
    let flexibleHoseCenterlineReady : Bool := false
    let drainageSemanticsReady : Bool := false
    let manufacturerExactTakeoutReady : Bool := primaryDimensionScheduleReady && sourceInsertOriginToPortOffsetReady && genericUnresolvedFittings == 0
    let properPipeLayoutReady : Bool := sourceAdjacencyReady && manufacturerExactTakeoutReady && flexibleHoseCenterlineReady && drainageSemanticsReady
    And (resolvedRigidFittings + unresolvedRigidFittings = rigidFittings)
      (And (identifiedVictaulicFittings + genericUnresolvedFittings = rigidFittings)
        (And (sourceAdjacencyReady = true)
          (And (primaryDimensionScheduleReady = true)
            (And (manufacturerExactTakeoutReady = false)
              (properPipeLayoutReady = false))))) :=
by decide
